scripts.dev:stop: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const ports=['3000','3001']; let found=false; for (const port of ports){ try { const out=execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :'+port,{encoding:'utf8'}); const pids=[...new Set(out.split(/\r?\n/).map(l=>l.trim()).filter(l=>l.includes('LISTENING')).map(l=>l.split(/\s+/).pop()).filter(p=>p&&/^\d+$/.test(p)&&p!=='0'))]; pids.forEach(pid=>{ try{execSync('taskkill /PID '+pid+' /T /F',{stdio:'inherit'}); found=true;}catch{}}); } catch {} } try{require('fs').unlinkSync(require('path').join('.next','dev','lock'));}catch{} if(!found) console.log('Nenhum servidor Next.js ativo.');"
